hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Answers to common questions on tower selection, burn rooms, modular systems, procurement, and maintenance.

items.q: Fixed tower or modular tower — how do I choose?
items.a: Fixed towers are structurally robust and closely resemble real buildings — ideal for permanent training complexes. Modular towers reconfigure and expand — ideal for phased budgets or changing scenarios. We can recommend based on your training objectives and site conditions.

items.q: Can training towers be customized?
items.a: Yes. Every building starts from a blank slate — floors, roof, doors, windows, breach points, burn rooms, and props can all be designed to your exact requirements. No two departments are exactly alike.

items.q: What material is used for burn room liner?
items.a: We use calcium silicate interlocking thermal liner for durability and insulation. Expansion gaps between panels and thermal air cavities between panels and structure provide effective insulation; individual panels can be removed for maintenance.

items.q: Are roof guardrails required?
items.a: For high-work safety, we recommend guardrails or parapets with toe boards on roof training areas to meet fall-protection requirements.

items.q: How is temperature controlled inside burn rooms?
items.a: We recommend temperature monitoring with sensors at ceiling and working height — controlling training temperature and extending liner service life.

items.q: Can gas simulators be added?
items.a: Yes. We integrate with leading gas simulator products for new builds and retrofits of existing facilities.

items.q: Can structures be expanded or relocated after completion?
items.a: Yes. Burn rooms and annexes can be added as teams grow; bolt-connected structures can even be disassembled and rebuilt at a new site.

items.q: Why steel structure instead of concrete?
items.a: Steel performs more consistently through repeated thermal cycles with more uniform expansion; total build and long-term maintenance costs are typically much lower; and damaged panels can be replaced — whereas concrete cracks are often expensive or impractical to repair.

items.q: How long does construction and installation take?
items.a: Timeline depends on tower size and customization. As a turnkey supplier with a single point of contact, we provide a clear production and installation schedule after design approval — typically completing on-site installation within weeks.

items.q: What foundation is required?
items.a: Column-free design distributes loads evenly, often simplifying foundation requirements. Specific foundation design follows structural calculations and site conditions — we advise during early planning.

items.q: What flooring material is used?
items.a: Floors are typically concrete at each level — closer to real fireground conditions and more durable.

items.q: How long will the building last?
items.a: Hot-dip galvanized steel structures, with proper use and regular maintenance, serve for decades — a long-term investment built to last.

items.q: How many stories can modules stack?
items.a: Pre-engineered design supports stable multi-story stacking with height increases available per project requirements.

items.q: How is it fundamentally different from shipping containers?
items.a: Modular systems use new materials and all-galvanized steel frames with open floor plans — walls and doors carry no structural load and move freely. Purpose-built for emergency training — things refurbished containers cannot match.

items.q: Are different sizes available?
items.a: Standard modules combine, stack, and connect freely to adapt to different sites and training scales.

items.q: What are the benefits of galvanized steel?
items.a: Zinc coating prevents steel corrosion, lowering maintenance cost and extending service life far beyond plain steel.

items.q: What is the procurement process?
items.a: Typically: needs consultation → design & selection → quote & contract → detailed design → production → installation & acceptance. See the How to Buy page for details.

items.q: Do you support government procurement or public bidding?
items.a: Yes. We provide complete technical specifications and qualification documents for public bidding and government procurement processes.

items.q: How long is the typical project timeline?
items.a: Timeline depends on tower size and customization. After design approval, we provide a clear production and installation schedule.

items.q: How is pricing calculated?
items.a: Pricing depends on the tower series, number of levels and height, functional configuration (burn rooms, props and accessories, etc.) and site conditions. We provide an itemized quotation covering design, manufacturing, shipping and installation — no hidden costs after signing.

items.q: Are your certifications complete?
items.a: We are certified to ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 14001 (environmental) and ISO 45001 (occupational health & safety), plus five-star after-sales service certification, and can supply the qualification documents required for government procurement and bidding.

items.q: How is after-sales support guaranteed?
items.a: We provide integrated design, manufacturing and installation warranty with itemized warranty policies, plus annual inspections, maintenance and spare parts support. Issues can be reported via online chat, phone or inquiry form, and are followed up by our after-sales team.

items.q: What are the site requirements?
items.a: Appropriate foundation and site conditions are required — we assess the site during early planning and advise on foundation design.

items.q: Do you provide installation and training?
items.a: Yes. We handle on-site installation and commissioning and train personnel on operation and maintenance so teams are productive from day one.

items.q: How is ongoing maintenance handled?
items.a: We provide annual inspection and maintenance service and replacement support for wear items such as liner panels.
